facts.text: Incoming freshmen qualify for automatic admission at UNI by earning a Regent Admission Index (RAI) score of at least 245 based on test scores, high school GPA, and completed core courses.

sources.title: RAI Score Admission
sources.quote: To qualify for automatic admission as freshmen, students must achieve a Regent Admission Index (RAI) score of at least 245.

sources.title: RAI Score Admission
sources.quote: The RAI combines factors that predict success: ACT or SAT test score, high school cumulative grade-point average and the number of completed high school core courses.
